name: build_pdf_1
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess, os
os.makedirs("output/pdf", exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("qa/tmp", exist_ok=True)
src="source/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.roff"
r1=subprocess.run(["groff","-Tps",src],capture_output=True)
print("groff rc",r1.returncode)
print("groff stderr:",r1.stderr.decode()[:4000])
open("qa/tmp/doc.ps","wb").write(r1.stdout)
r2=subprocess.run(["ps2pdf","qa/tmp/doc.ps","output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf"],capture_output=True)
print("ps2pdf rc",r2.returncode, r2.stderr.decode()[:1000])
r3=subprocess.run(["pdfinfo","output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf"],capture_output=True)
print(r3.stdout.decode())
